# botdot

> A self-hosted team of Claude Code bots you run by chat. Each bot is a Claude Code agent with one job and its own tools, permissions, workspace and schedule. The owner tells the Chief of Staff what they need in a chat; it makes the bots, runs them and reports back, and anything risky waits for the owner's OK in Needs you. It runs on the owner's own Linux server (each account walled off under rootless Docker and gVisor) and is used from the web page, the Android app and the desktop app for Windows, Mac and Linux. It uses the official Claude Code CLI with the owner's own Claude subscription or API key. MIT licensed, no telemetry.

Install on a fresh Linux server or VM (not a container) as a user with sudo:

```sh
git clone https://github.com/Kordal/bot-dot.git bot-dot-source
sudo sh bot-dot-source/install.sh
```

It needs at least 4 CPUs, 8 GB of RAM and 40 GB of free disk; Ubuntu 22.04 or newer, Debian 12 or 13, Fedora, or RHEL 9 or 10 and its rebuilds; a Claude Pro or Max subscription or an Anthropic API key; and a domain pointed at the server or a Tailscale tailnet.
